name: Roll Cart
summary: An Add to cart pill where a cart rolls in, catches a box, revs up and zooms off
about: A product card with an Add to cart button that plays a short story. The button squashes, a cart rolls in and brakes, a parcel drops in with a thud, a progress bar fills while the engine shakes, and the cart zooms away. The button turns green with a ripple and confetti while a +1 coin hops into the cart badge.
how: Press Add to cart: the button squashes and the label lifts away
A cart rolls in from the left and brakes with a springy wobble
A box falls in and the cart squashes on impact
A progress bar fills while the cart shakes and puffs smoke
The cart winds back and zooms off with speed lines
The button turns green, confetti bursts and a +1 coin hops to the cart badge
After a moment the button resets; Empty cart clears the count
